items.name: ashen-realm-gameplay-trailer
items.prompt: Cinematic gameplay trailer for a browser-based dark fantasy dungeon RPG, presented as a polished real-time game rather than a movie. Hyper-realistic AAA visual target: physically based materials, photoreal stone crypts, wet reflective floors, volumetric torch smoke, dense atmospheric fog, realistic cloth, steel, leather, skin and creature surfaces, dramatic global illumination, sharp high-detail presentation. Start with a lone armored player character entering an individual instanced dungeon through a ruined gothic gate. Transition into third-person gameplay: responsive dodge roll, sword parry, heavy attack, magic ability, enemy health bars and minimal premium HUD. Show highly realistic original character and monster designs: scarred human dungeon knight in dark plate and leather, skeletal revenants with weathered armor, a huge horned subterranean demon with realistic musculature and cracked obsidian skin, and a pale dungeon stalker creature. Show combat in narrow corridors, traps, loot chest interaction, inventory/equipment panel, then a boss arena fight. Include brief mobile iPhone browser gameplay framing with large ergonomic thumb controls, readable buttons, safe-area spacing, smooth touch camera controls, then return to full-screen desktop browser gameplay. No sign-in wall: title screen immediately offers PLAY / CONTINUE and enters the dungeon. Visual language should suggest Unreal Engine 5 quality while remaining an original game, 4K-master cinematic detail, stable geometry, consistent character identity, realistic animation, high-end game trailer camera work. End on a wide shot of the player facing the enormous dungeon boss with title text: ASHEN REALM — ENTER THE DUNGEON. No logos of existing games, no copyrighted characters.

items.name: crypt-warden-photoreal-reference
items.prompt: Photorealistic dark-fantasy game character, photographed like a real actor in handcrafted practical costume for a high-budget film. SINGLE full-body character, crown/head to boot soles entirely visible, centered on a plain neutral medium-grey studio background, flat soft neutral illumination revealing all material detail. Near-front view with only a tiny 8-degree turn. Natural human proportions, head about one-eighth total body height, anatomical hands, arms in a relaxed A-pose 30 degrees away from torso, hands empty with fingers visible, legs slightly apart. The sole subject must be an actual lifelike believable physical character, not an illustration, cartoon, plastic toy, glossy statue or low-poly model. Excellent reference for image-to-3D reconstruction. No weapons, props, pedestal, smoke, text, collage or environment. CRYPT WARDEN, height2.05m. An unnerving emaciated undead ancient guardian, realistic anatomically accurate human skull with hollow eye sockets and subtle dim amber pinprick eyes, cracked stained porous bone, real tiny human teeth and cheekbones, no grin caricature. Desiccated corpse-grey leathery flesh stretched over lean human anatomy, neck tendons, sparse rib exposure anatomically correctly curved and small, sinewy arms and clawed fingers. Asymmetric fractured bone lamellar shoulder guard strapped on with rotten leather, torn dull charcoal burial cloth around waist and shins. No crown. Narrow anatomical feet with real toes, convincing joints, old weathered metal restraints. Non-graphic, no blood/gore, no exposed organs. Long skull proportions rather than giant round cranium. Fine skin creases, pores, cracked bone surfaces, irregular aged cloth.
